title: Cellular sense-making need not be conscious (2004 view)

statements.text: In 2004 Thompson held that the sense-making of life shows an organism’s autonomy and coupling but not necessarily consciousness. Minimal cellular selfhood seems to lack intentional access and pre-reflective self-awareness, which would need the reflexive elaboration of life processes that a nervous system provides.
